name: v3.31.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: resolve 20 repository review findings across research and storage by @iliaal in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1326
* chore(deps): bump github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go from 1.2.1 to 1.3.0 in /mcp by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1330
* chore(deps): bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.6.4 to 0.7.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1331
* chore(deps): bump google/osv-scanner-action/.github/workflows/osv-scanner-reusable.yml from 2.6.0 to 2.7.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1332
* chore(deps): bump actions/upload-artifact from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1333
* chore(deps): bump github/codeql-action/upload-sarif from 4.38.3 to 4.39.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1334
* fix(youtube): cap paid transcript rescues at the target and request every -orig track first by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1321
* fix: don't prescribe a yt-dlp upgrade for a YouTube timeout by @giuseppebisemi in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1327
* fix: enforce person identity before expansion and ranking by @ElliotDrel in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1325
* fix(github): distinguish repository metrics from comments by @Navlem in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1329
* fix(grounding): keep undated keyless web results instead of dropping the whole web lane by @francoislejunk in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1312
* fix(tiktok): preserve collected videos at the stream deadline by @monsterlag in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1318
* fix(grok): audit each grok build locally instead of pinning 1.0.46 by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1337
* fix: return a YouTube lane's videos when it runs out of time by @giuseppebisemi in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1328
* feat: add Dia to macOS Chromium-family cookie extraction by @arkadevbanerjee in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/929
* fix(youtube): return YouTube results for every entity in comparisons by @tmchow in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1336
* fix(instagram): classify ScrapeCreators no-reels 404 as no results by @OKAN-SOFTWARE in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1338
* refactor(github): replace legacy footer classifier with static fields by @tmchow in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1339
* feat(reddit): arctic-shift fallback for shreddit comment enrichment by @technicianofthesacred in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/961
* fix(reddit): stop the arctic comment fallback at the enrichment budget by @tmchow in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1340
* chore(release): bump version to 3.31.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1341

## New Contributors
* @ElliotDrel made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1325
* @Navlem made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1329
* @francoislejunk made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1312
* @monsterlag made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1318
* @arkadevbanerjee made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/929
* @OKAN-SOFTWARE made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1338

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/compare/v3.30.0...v3.31.0
